name: Tivat Airport

runway.v: one runway, 14/32, 2,500 m x 45 m, asphalt

notes: AIP for Montenegro is published by SMATSA (smatsa.rs/en/aip); no AD 2 LYTV page was found by search, and the constructed eAIP page (AIRAC 15 May 2025 path) was blocked (permission not answered). Operator's General Aviation page (https://montenegroairports.com/en/tivat-airport/general-aviation/) blocked (permission not answered). Operator page (3 Jun 2024) also lists a General Aviation apron, positions 8-14, each 20 m. Civil Aviation Agency LYTV safety briefing (Edition 1.0, 9 Mar 2023; IATA TIV printed in its header 'LY LYTV / TIVAT / TIV') warns of a short runway strip and no RESA on runway 32, backtracking on the runway for departure, visual-only landings on runway 14 in strong southerly wind, and says the aerodrome had no runway, taxiway or approach lighting; the 2024 operator page now lists approach lighting for both runways, so lighting and night use must be checked in the current AIP.
